description: Firms on the tracker with their kinds, open-role count, categories and places, busiest first. Filters: `name` substring, `kind` (proprietary-trading-firms, hedge-funds, investment-banks, banks, advisory-boutiques, private-equity-firms, venture-capital-firms, asset-managers, private-banks-and-wealth-managers, exchanges-and-market-infrastructure, commodity-and-energy-firms, insurers-and-reinsurers, crypto-firms, brokers-and-trading-platforms, fintech-firms, strategy-consulting-firms, economic-consulting-firms, technology-firms, real-estate-investors), `country` (ISO2 or name) and `city` (firms with a role open there). By default only firms hiring today; `include_quiet: true` adds every firm with nothing open right now (the site's "firms with no open roles"), which is the full directory. That includes firms with no careers page of their own that post their openings on LinkedIn: they carry `jobs_on_linkedin`, their LinkedIn jobs page. Each firm links to its page on the site.

city.description: A city page slug or name, e.g. london, newyork, amsterdam (see list_cities)

country.description: ISO2 code or country name, e.g. NL, GB, "United Kingdom"

include_quiet.description: Also list firms with no open role right now

kind.description: Kind of firm slug, e.g. hedge-funds, investment-banks, proprietary-trading-firms (see list_companies)

name: list_companies
title: Firms on the tracker
